title: deeplethe/forkd
claim: forkd — fork() for AI-agent microVMs: keep one warm KVM parent, then spawn 100 copy-on-write children in ~100ms or branch a live VM in ~56ms. Rust, Apache-2.0, Python SDK, portable snapshot hub.
why_good: fork() for agent microVMs — one warm KVM parent spawns 100 copy-on-write children in ~100ms, killing agent cold-starts at scale.
value: Infra sold to agent platforms/clouds that run many parallel sandboxes; usage + enterprise, a real perf primitive.
risk: Deep infra with a narrow expert buyer; competes with Firecracker/E2B internals and needs serious reliability proof.

zh.claim: forkd —— 给 AI-agent microVM 的 fork():保留一个热 KVM 父机,~100ms 内派生 100 个写时复制子机。
zh.why_good: 给 agent microVM 的 fork()——一个热 KVM 父机 ~100ms 派生 100 个写时复制子机,规模化地干掉 agent 冷启动。
zh.value: 卖给跑大量并行沙箱的 agent 平台/云:按量 + 企业版,一个真实的性能原语。
zh.risk: 深度基础设施、专家买家窄;要和 Firecracker/E2B 的内部机制竞争,需要扎实的可靠性证明。
